title: He Sings Over You
old_p1: Zephaniah was a prophet who lived when good King Josiah was king. A prophet is a man who speaks for Heavenly Father.
Zephaniah told about a happy day to come, the day Jesus comes again. He said, “Sing… be glad and rejoice with all the heart.” Rejoice means to be very glad.
He said the Lord will be “in the midst of thee.” That means right there with you, close by. He said, “Fear thou not.”
old_p2: Zephaniah said the Lord “will rejoice over thee with joy.” He said the Lord “will joy over thee with singing”! The Lord is so happy with His children, it is like singing over them, the way a mom sings over her baby.
The Lord loves you that much! Tonight, as you close your eyes, picture Him smiling over you with joy.
p1: Zephaniah told the people what Heavenly Father said. Many people had turned away from the Lord, and hard days were coming.
But Zephaniah told of a happy day to come. He said, “Be glad and rejoice with all the heart.” The Lord would be “in the midst of thee,” right there with them.
Zephaniah was talking about Jesus! He said, “Fear thou not.” No one needs to be afraid when Jesus is near.
p2: Zephaniah said the Lord “will rejoice over thee with joy.” He said the Lord “will joy over thee with singing”! He is so happy with His children, like a mom singing over her baby.
The Lord loves you that much! Tonight, as you snuggle down, picture Him smiling over you with joy.
